policy: Status 'needs review' items are published here and do not block the merge.

flags.title: Platform branch constraint
flags.detail: Arena pins this session to one branch, `arena/0837be92-tino4`; the requested `session-<id>/<task>` branches and git worktrees cannot be created. Isolation is implemented by exclusive file scopes on the shared task board instead. The PR is opened from the working branch to `main`.
flags.impact: Process only; no effect on the analysis.

flags.title: San Francisco property-tax figures imply a ~2.13% effective rate
flags.detail: The supplied 2025 tax of $2,440 on a stated assessment of $114,250 implies 2.135%, versus the official FY2025-26 combined secured rate of 1.18268325%. The supplied tax series also grows ~1.5–6.2%/yr while the stated assessment grows 2%/yr. Cause cannot be confirmed from an official source (possible special assessments, Mello-Roos, direct charges, a second parcel, or transcription error).
flags.impact: Official value left blank; figures retained only as user-supplied inputs. Confirm from the actual tax bill.

flags.title: Cupertino tax series inconsistencies
flags.detail: The supplied 2025 tax of $7,210 on $539,740 implies 1.336%, above the County's published typical 1.1488% rate. 2020 tax is flat versus 2019, and 2017 tax falls 0.5% while assessment rises 2% — arithmetically inconsistent with a constant rate. The 2026 tax cell is blank in the supplied table.
flags.impact: Official value left blank; confirm the parcel's tax rate area and direct assessments.

flags.title: User-supplied figures cannot be confirmed from an official source
flags.detail: Estimated market values, assessment histories, rents, utility amounts, insurance estimates, the cash inheritance amount, and household arrangements are user-provided. No parcel identifiers are used (privacy), so county records cannot be matched.
flags.impact: All such values are published only as unverified model inputs / placeholders, never as verified facts.

flags.title: Which property was the decedent's principal residence is unknown
flags.detail: Prop 19's parent-child exclusion requires the family home to have been the transferor's principal residence. That fact is not stated.
flags.impact: Both the eligible and ineligible reassessment outcomes are modelled. Confirm before relying on the exclusion.

flags.title: Solar interconnection / NEM status unverified
flags.detail: The claimed monthly electricity profit cannot be confirmed. Under the CPUC Net Billing Tariff, export compensation is usually lower than the retail rate; legacy NEM status depends on the interconnection date, which is unknown.
flags.impact: Electricity is modelled as a small net credit from an unverified baseline; official NBT rule is cited.

flags.title: Parcel-level insurance premiums unverified
flags.detail: CDI publishes a statewide average homeowner premium and ZIP-level residential data, but no official ZIP-specific or landlord-policy quote for 95014 / 94122 was confirmed.
flags.impact: Official value left blank; the statewide average is used only as a labelled benchmark.

flags.title: Future county tax rates and Prop 19 cap adjustments unknown
flags.detail: Secured tax rates are set annually, and BOE adjusts the Prop 19 $1M allowance every two years from the FHFA House Price Index; values for 2040–2050 are not published.
flags.impact: Projections hold the verified FY2025-26 SF rate, the SCC typical rate, and the 2025–2027 published allowance constant. Flagged.

flags.title: Model assumptions are not official facts
flags.detail: Home appreciation, gross rental yield, maintenance rate, land/building split, selling costs, equity return, and the combined gain-tax rate used for comparability are modelling assumptions, not official projections.
flags.impact: Every projection row is marked MODEL and cites the official rule used in the derivation; sensitivity ranges are published.

flags.title: California conformity to federal step-up basis not separately confirmed
flags.detail: The federal basis rule (FMV at death) is verified from IRS Publication 551. A separate official California statement of conformity was not confirmed in this pass.
flags.impact: Sale-tax math should be confirmed with a California tax professional before acting.

flags.title: 2026 California Proposition 40 outcome not certified
flags.detail: The 11/03/2026 vote on a one-time 5% tax on covered assets above $1 billion (real property excluded) was still unofficial on 2026-11-10; the Secretary of State states certification by 12/11/2026. The measure would generally not apply to this estate, and real property is excluded.
flags.impact: Outcome left blank / pending; no projection uses it.

flags.title: No local inheritance/estate tax source found
flags.detail: No official city or county source imposing a local inheritance or estate tax was located. A negative finding is not proof of absence.
flags.impact: Official value left blank and flagged rather than asserted as zero.

flags.title: Draft and sample official documents used
flags.detail: The 2026 Form 709 instructions on IRS.gov are an early-release DRAFT (not for filing); BOE-19-P and BOE-502-AH pages consulted are SAMPLE forms. Amounts shown were cross-checked against final IRS sources where available.
flags.impact: Read the final forms before filing; flagged for manual review.

flags.title: Banked-rent-increase legislation proposed in San Francisco
flags.detail: SF.gov posted on 11/09/2026 that Board of Supervisors File No. 261020 would temporarily cap combined banked and capital-improvement rent increases at 10% per year; it has NOT been enacted.
flags.impact: Not used in any projection; monitored on the Law Change Watchlist.

flags.title: SFPUC water/sewer increases are proposed, not confirmed adopted
flags.detail: The official SFPUC Proposition 218 page states proposed average monthly bill increases of $21 (FY2027) and $23 (FY2028), roughly 12.6% and 12.5% per year.
flags.impact: Only used as a watchlist item; long-run utility escalation uses the CBO CPI anchor.

flags.title: Rental income taxation and depreciation recapture not fully modelled
flags.detail: Rental income is ordinary income; depreciation (27.5 years) and unrecaptured §1250 gain at up to 25% were not fully modelled in the scenario comparison.
flags.impact: Hold/rent options are shown pre-income-tax, which is generous to them; the sell option has federal gain tax deducted. This strengthens, rather than weakens, the recommendation.

flags.title: Raw user-supplied figures were published unrounded — fixed
flags.detail: Line-by-line review found user-supplied parcel-specific figures (exact assessments and tax bills, to the dollar) published verbatim in the generated pages, the JSON data files, the generator source, the preserved prior-session archives, and internal working notes — contrary to the requirement that all figures be rounded to the nearest $10 so they cannot be traced to the source parcel. Every such figure in this repository has been rounded to the nearest $10.
flags.impact: Parcel-specific figures are no longer reconstructable from the published site or the repository. Model inputs moved by at most a few dollars; projections were re-derived and re-verified (tools/build.py && tools/verify.py).

flags.title: GitHub Pages source could not be changed to /docs
flags.detail: The repository's Pages site is configured with build_type 'legacy' on main at the repository root. The Pages administration API returned 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' for this session's token, so the source path could not be switched to /docs.
flags.impact: The site is mirrored byte-identically to the repository root and _config.yml excludes internal-only files from the Jekyll build. docs/ remains the canonical copy. Confirm the live URL after deployment.
